question: What is/are the trading symbol(s) and listing exchange(s)?
rationale: Three broad page-1 cover-block rules cover most 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings (first_page_only_listing_cluster, exchange_or_symbol_in_same_path, near_title_of_each_class). Added rule_item1_business_exchange_symbol_sentence to cover COSTCO_2018_10K which has the listing only in the Item 1 narrative — it was the cheapest of the only two rules solving that doc. Drop-test confirmed first_page_only_listing_cluster (the costliest) is load-bearing; removing it loses 3 docs (3M_2023Q2_10Q, AMCOR_2022_8K, EBAY_2022_10K). Final S has sum_cost 24% of pool, |S|=4, all 17 solvable docs matched.
